decision: Approved source-semantic equivalent one-line alpha-check iteration change.
verification: Verified exact sole replacement in this file against reviewed peer commit; no suppression.
RGBA length is width*height*4 and each row chunks at width*4. Width and height are nonzero and bounded <=1080, so each row length is divisible by4.
Both expressions inspect the same alpha byte in each complete four-byte pixel, same order and short-circuit behavior; no remainder exists here, neither allocates or mutates pixels.
as_chunks::<4> uses nonzero const N, so introduces no zero-chunk panic.
Official Rust slice docs mark as_chunks stable since1.88.0, predating native Rust1.91.1; API availability compatible.
limits: No compilation or tests performed by reviewer; root owns reruns.
Earlier peer native test evidence remains tied to original postimage; this addendum establishes semantic/API equivalence only.
